fieldValues.title: Cycle and report
fieldValues.article_text: The cycle is a rhythm set here, not a fixed week. Current rhythm: daily; the cycle closes at 11:30 UTC. The owner can amend the rhythm. At each close the steward closes the cycle and posts a short report on the programme's report issue (setting report_issue), a comment whose first line is `<!-- wg-report cycle=<YYYY-MM-DD> -->`. The report uses the standard run-report headings plus figures: PRs merged with their quorum line, PRs open, stops, red gates, budget used and pause state. The owner acknowledges a report with a thumbs-up (+1) reaction from the owner account on the report comment. The group pauses after N=2 consecutive unacknowledged cycle reports. While paused, pr-upkeep merges no group PRs, the builder opens nothing new, and reviews and escalations continue. A thumbs-up on a report lifts the pause.
fieldValues.rationale: The owner sets the rhythm so each report stays one cycle and short; the pause stops delegated work piling up unread.
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Owner only: an amendment needs a new owner-ratified decision.
fieldValues.protected_status: Agent testimony until the owner ratifies the charter decision.
